p: Welcome to the EasyApps Documentation Page.

EasyApps is a brand-new application solution for Discord servers. All actions can be executed directly from Discord. This guide is designed for all users, regardless of prior experience with other Discord bots. It provides detailed information regarding each command.
If you have any questions, you can visit our support server or go over the FAQ page. We are ready to assist you with your inquiries.
EasyApps is very easy to set up, requiring only a few seconds before you can begin building your applications.
To set up EasyApps, the server owner must run the command: /server_setup During this process, you will be asked to give:
The Application Reviewer role ID
The Application Manager role ID
After submitting the required information, the setup is complete. You can immediately begin creating and managing applications.
Only the server owner can run the /server_setup command.
Welcome to the EasyApps FAQ page. This page is organized into two sections: one for general users and one for server managers.
What is EasyApps? EasyApps is a Discord bot that lets servers create and manage applications easily.
How do I apply? Use the application command "/apply" in the server.
Can I edit my application after submitting? No, once submitted, applications cannot be edited. Contact staff if needed.

How long does it take to get a response? This depends per server as we dont manage submitted applications for each server. But normally servers respond applications 24h-48h after submitting. For more information we suggest you contact server staff as they are the one´s who manage applications you submit.
What happens after I apply? Your application is sent to staff for review. You may receive a role or a response depending on the result.
Who can see my application? Only authorized staff members in the server.

How do I create an application? Use the /create_application command. This opens a setup panel where you configure everything. Refer to https://docs.easy-apps.xyz/gettingstarted/setup/ for a more detailed guide.
What do I need to create an application? You must set: -Log Channel (required) -Application Name -Application status (open/closed) -Roles (passed, failed, applied) -Questions list
What is the Log Channel? The channel where submitted applications are sent for staff review. ⚠️ This is required to create an application.
Can I customize questions? Yes, EasyApps supports unlimited questions. You can create, edit, remove, and reorder them in the Questions Editing section.
Can I edit an existing application? Yes, use /edit_application to reopen the setup panel and make changes.
How do I remove an application? Use /remove_application to fully delete it.
Is there a limit to applications? No, you can create unlimited applications.

To import an application, prepare a JSON file with the following format:
{ "appName": "", "logChannel": 0, "opened": "False",
Fill in the data, while ensuring the format stays the same so:
Strings are in between quotes.
ID's are numbers.
There are comas after everything except last line.
Opened can be either: "True" or "False".
To add more questions, add a coma after the last pair of quotes, insert new pair of quotes and in between those add the question name.
The last 3 IDs, do not need to be filled.
